name: new-transmission-tool
description: Transmission Dashboard with Hono, React, and Wired Elements

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:backend: cross-env PORT=3300 npm run dev --prefix backend
scripts.dev:frontend: cross-env BACKEND_PORT=3300 npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: cross-env PORT=3300 BACKEND_PORT=3300 concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:alt: cross-env PORT=3301 BACKEND_PORT=3301 concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
